audit.pedagogicalValue: Forms a passive about a person receiving assistance.

items.setupText: Choose the sentence saying the letter was not sent.

items.answer: The letter wasn't sent.

Was sent says posting happened, contrary to the stated situation.
Wasn't sent denies the sending event and matches the letter remaining unposted.
